sloka: विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा ।भरतं चैव सौमित्रे युष्माकं या च सन्ततिः ।। ७.१०५.७ ॥
transliteration: viṣayaṁ tvāṁ puraṁ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṁ tathā ।bharataṁ caiva saumitre yuṣmākaṁ yā ca santatiḥ ।। 7.105.7 ॥

translations.english: ...then I shall curse your kingdom, you, the city, Rama, and also Bharata, O son of Sumitra, and all your progeny.
